title: Dashboard loads after login and shows key widgets
description: Verifies an authenticated user can reach the Dashboard and see the main dashboard sections rendered.

title: Quick action Enviar navigates to /dashboard/send
description: Verifies the Enviar quick action from the Dashboard takes the user to the Send page.

title: Quick action Recargar navigates to /dashboard/receive
description: Verifies the Recargar quick action from the Dashboard takes the user to the Receive page.

title: Recent transactions list is visible on Dashboard
description: Verifies the Dashboard shows a visible recent transactions section/list for an authenticated user.

title: Sidebar send money form is visible on Dashboard
description: Verifies the send money form in the Dashboard sidebar renders and is usable at a basic UI level.

steps.description: Verify element "Send money form" is visible

title: Send money form validation: attempt submit with empty fields
description: Verifies the sidebar send money form prevents submission and shows visible validation errors when required fields are empty.

steps.description: Click the "Enviar" (Send) button within the sidebar send money form

title: Send money form validation: non-numeric amount shows error
description: Verifies the sidebar send money form shows a visible error when the amount is not a valid number.

steps.description: Type "test" into the "Amount" field in the sidebar send money form
Click the "Enviar" (Send) button within the sidebar send money form

title: Dashboard supports scrolling and keeps key sections accessible
description: Verifies the user can scroll the Dashboard and still see the recent transactions section content rendered.

title: Paginate forward in the transactions list
description: Verifies an authenticated user can move to the next page of the paginated transactions list.

steps.description: Click on "Transacciones" in the main navigation

title: Paginate backward in the transactions list
description: Verifies an authenticated user can move back to the previous page after navigating forward.

steps.description: Click on "Transacciones" in the main navigation

title: Filter transactions by each available type option
description: Verifies the transaction type filter can be changed and the list remains usable after each change.

steps.description: Click on "Transacciones" in the main navigation
Select "Todas" from the transaction type filter dropdown
Select "Recibidas" from the transaction type filter dropdown
Select "Enviadas" from the transaction type filter dropdown

title: Transactions page shows a loading state before list appears
description: Verifies the transactions page displays a visible loading state while fetching transactions, then shows the list.

steps.description: Click on "Transacciones" in the main navigation
Wait for element "Transactions list" to appear

title: Graceful empty state when no transactions match a filter
description: Verifies the UI shows a clear empty state when a selected transaction type has no results.

steps.description: Click on "Transacciones" in the main navigation
Select "Reembolsos" from the transaction type filter dropdown
Verify text "No hay transacciones" is visible

title: Successful service payment redirects to payment processing and success pages
description: Verifies a user can submit a valid service payment and is redirected through processing to the success confirmation page.

steps.description: Click on "Servicios" (Services) in the app navigation
Select a service provider from the provider dropdown
Type "1234567890" into the account/reference number field
Type "50" into the payment amount field

title: Providers list is visible when opening provider dropdown
description: Verifies the provider dropdown displays a list of providers for selection.

steps.description: Click on "Servicios" (Services) in the app navigation

title: Invalid amount shows a visible payment error message and stays on Services page
description: Verifies submitting an invalid amount results in an on-page error and does not navigate to the processing page.

steps.description: Click on "Servicios" (Services) in the app navigation
Select a service provider from the provider dropdown
Type "1234567890" into the account/reference number field
Type "-10" into the payment amount field

title: Missing provider prevents payment submission with a visible validation message
description: Verifies the form requires selecting a provider before payment can be initiated.

steps.description: Click on "Servicios" (Services) in the app navigation
Type "1234567890" into the account/reference number field
Type "25" into the payment amount field

title: Missing account/reference number prevents payment submission with a visible validation message
description: Verifies the form requires an account/reference number before payment can be initiated.

steps.description: Click on "Servicios" (Services) in the app navigation
Select a service provider from the provider dropdown
Type "" into the account/reference number field
Type "25" into the payment amount field

title: Missing amount prevents payment submission with a visible validation message
description: Verifies the form requires an amount before payment can be initiated.

steps.description: Click on "Servicios" (Services) in the app navigation
Select a service provider from the provider dropdown
Type "1234567890" into the account/reference number field
Type "" into the payment amount field

title: Amount with too many decimals is rejected with a visible error
description: Verifies the payment amount input enforces a valid currency format and shows an error when invalid.

steps.description: Click on "Servicios" (Services) in the app navigation
Select a service provider from the provider dropdown
Type "1234567890" into the account/reference number field
Type "10.999" into the payment amount field

title: Change password successfully from Security > Password tab
description: Verifies a logged-in user can submit the change password form and sees a visible success confirmation.

steps.description: Click the "Seguridad" (Security) option in the app navigation
Verify element "Cambiar contraseña" (Change Password) button is visible

title: Password change form validates required fields when submitted empty
description: Verifies the password change form shows visible validation when submitted without required inputs.

steps.description: Click the "Seguridad" (Security) option in the app navigation

title: Incorrect current password shows error on password change
description: Verifies submitting an incorrect current password results in a visible error message.

steps.description: Click the "Seguridad" (Security) option in the app navigation
Type "incorrecta-123" into the current password field

title: New password and confirmation mismatch is blocked with validation message
description: Verifies the UI prevents submission when the new password and confirmation do not match.

steps.description: Click the "Seguridad" (Security) option in the app navigation
Type "{{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}" into the current password field
Type "NuevaClave-123" into the new password field
Type "NuevaClave-456" into the confirm new password field

title: Submit a support request from Contact tab successfully
description: Verifies an authenticated user can submit the support contact form and see a visible success confirmation.

steps.description: Click on "Support" in the main navigation/menu
Type "Consulta sobre mi cuenta" into the subject field
Type "Necesito ayuda con una duda relacionada con mi cuenta. Por favor, contáctenme." into the message field

title: Contact form validation when submitting with empty required fields
description: Verifies required-field validation is shown when submitting an empty contact form.

steps.description: Click on "Support" in the main navigation/menu

title: Contact form validation clears after entering subject and message
description: Verifies validation errors can be resolved by providing required inputs and a submit can proceed to success state.

steps.description: Click on "Support" in the main navigation/menu
Type "Problema con transferencia" into the subject field
Type "Estoy teniendo problemas para completar una transferencia. ¿Podrían ayudarme?" into the message field

title: Navigate to Support and view FAQ content
description: Verifies the FAQ tab is accessible and displays FAQ items that can be read.

steps.description: Click on "Support" in the main navigation/menu
Verify element "FAQ items list" is visible

title: Resources tab shows resource links
description: Verifies the Resources tab is accessible and shows visible resource links for users.

steps.description: Click on "Support" in the main navigation/menu

title: Switching tabs preserves navigation and shows correct tab content
description: Verifies a user can switch among Contact, FAQ, and Resources tabs and see each tab’s visible content area.

steps.description: Click on "Support" in the main navigation/menu
Verify element "FAQ items list" is visible

title: Contact form allows long message content without breaking submission
description: Verifies the contact form can accept a long message and still submit to a visible success confirmation.

steps.description: Click on "Support" in the main navigation/menu
Type "Solicitud detallada" into the subject field

Type "Hola, necesito ayuda con un tema. He intentado varias veces resolverlo desde la app y no he podido. Agradezco si me indican los pasos exactos o si pueden revisar mi caso. Gracias." into the message field

title: Send money successfully with description and verify it appears in transaction history list
description: Authenticated user sends money to a valid recipient with an optional description and sees confirmation plus an entry in transaction history.

steps.description: Click on "Enviar dinero" or "Send Money" in the app navigation
Type "qa.recipient@example.com" into the recipient email field
Type "5" into the transfer amount field
Type "Prueba de envío" into the description/concept field
Click on "Transacciones" (Transactions) in the app navigation

title: Send money successfully without description (optional field)
description: Authenticated user sends money without a description and still gets a success confirmation.

steps.description: Click on "Enviar dinero" or "Send Money" in the app navigation
Type "qa.recipient@example.com" into the recipient email field
Type "1" into the transfer amount field

title: Invalid recipient email shows an error message
description: User enters an invalid recipient email and sees a visible validation or submission error.

steps.description: Click on "Enviar dinero" or "Send Money" in the app navigation
Type "correo-invalido" into the recipient email field
Type "5" into the transfer amount field

title: Non-existent recipient email shows invalid recipient error
description: User enters a well-formed email that does not belong to an OpenPay user and sees an invalid recipient error.

steps.description: Click on "Enviar dinero" or "Send Money" in the app navigation
Type "noexiste.openpay.user.999999@example.com" into the recipient email field
Type "3" into the transfer amount field

title: Insufficient funds error when amount exceeds available balance
description: User attempts to send more money than available and sees an insufficient funds error message.

steps.description: Click on "Enviar dinero" or "Send Money" in the app navigation
Type "qa.recipient@example.com" into the recipient email field
Type "999999" into the transfer amount field

title: Required field validation when submitting with empty recipient and amount
description: Submitting the form without filling required fields shows visible validation errors and does not show success.

steps.description: Click on "Enviar dinero" or "Send Money" in the app navigation

title: Amount field rejects non-numeric input or shows validation error
description: Entering a non-numeric amount results in a visible validation error (or prevents submission) and no success message.

steps.description: Click on "Enviar dinero" or "Send Money" in the app navigation
Type "qa.recipient@example.com" into the recipient email field
Type "abc" into the transfer amount field

title: Zero or negative amount is not allowed
description: User enters 0 or a negative number for amount and sees a visible validation error instead of success.

steps.description: Click on "Enviar dinero" or "Send Money" in the app navigation
Type "qa.recipient@example.com" into the recipient email field
Type "0" into the transfer amount field

title: Create a new transfer and return to transfers list
description: Verifies a user can start from Transfers, create a new transfer, submit it, and return to the Transfers list view.

steps.description: Click on "Transfers" in the app navigation menu

title: Open the New Transfer page from Transfers list
description: Verifies the user can navigate from Transfers list to the Create New Transfer page using the UI control.

steps.description: Click on "Transfers" in the app navigation menu
Click on the "Create new transfer" button

title: Submit a new transfer request from /transfers/new
description: Verifies the transfer form can be filled and submitted, resulting in a post-submit confirmation or navigation away from the form.

steps.description: Click on "Transfers" in the app navigation menu
Click on the "Create new transfer" button

title: Transfer form validation: attempt to submit with empty required fields
description: Verifies the new transfer form prevents submission and shows visible validation errors when required fields are missing.

steps.description: Click on "Transfers" in the app navigation menu
Click on the "Create new transfer" button

title: Cancel out of creating a new transfer and return to Transfers list
description: Verifies the user can exit the new transfer flow using a cancel/back control and return to the transfers list.

steps.description: Click on "Transfers" in the app navigation menu
Click on the "Create new transfer" button

title: Resilience: Transfers page loads and remains usable after refresh-like navigation
description: Verifies the Transfers page can be visited from the dashboard repeatedly without breaking the list UI (basic stability check).

steps.description: Click on "Transfers" in the app navigation menu
Click on "Dashboard" in the app navigation menu

title: View contacts list page loads and shows list section
description: Verifies the Contacts page loads for an authenticated user and displays the contact list area.

steps.description: Click on "Contacts" in the main navigation

title: Add a new contact successfully and see it in the list
description: Verifies a user can add a new contact with a valid name and email and then see it listed.

steps.description: Click on "Contacts" in the main navigation
Click on the "Add new contact" button
Type "Contacto E2E Uno" into the contact name field
Type "contacto.e2e.uno@example.com" into the contact email field
Verify text "Contacto E2E Uno" is visible

title: Attempt to add contact with invalid email shows validation error
description: Verifies invalid email input is rejected and a validation message is shown.

steps.description: Click on "Contacts" in the main navigation
Click on the "Add new contact" button
Type "Contacto Email Malo" into the contact name field
Type "no-es-email" into the contact email field

title: Invalid email attempt does not create a visible new contact
description: Verifies that after a failed save due to invalid email, the contact name does not appear in the list.

steps.description: Click on "Contacts" in the main navigation
Click on the "Add new contact" button
Type "No Debe Guardarse" into the contact name field
Type "invalido@" into the contact email field
Verify text "No Debe Guardarse" is not visible

title: Required field validation when trying to save with empty name
description: Verifies the UI prevents saving a contact when the name field is empty and shows a validation error.

steps.description: Click on "Contacts" in the main navigation
Click on the "Add new contact" button
Type "contacto.sin.nombre@example.com" into the contact email field

title: Cancel out of add contact flow without saving
description: Verifies the user can exit the add contact UI without creating a contact.

steps.description: Click on "Contacts" in the main navigation
Click on the "Add new contact" button
Type "Contacto Cancelado" into the contact name field
Verify text "Contacto Cancelado" is not visible

title: Update profile information and save successfully
description: Verifies a logged-in user can navigate to Profile settings, update profile fields, save, and see a success confirmation.

steps.description: Click on "Settings" / "Configuración" in the main navigation
Verify text "Guardado" or "Cambios guardados" or "Actualizado" is visible

title: Change notification preferences and save successfully
description: Verifies a logged-in user can navigate to Notifications settings, toggle preferences, save, and see a confirmation.

steps.description: Click on "Settings" / "Configuración" in the main navigation
Click the first visible notification preference toggle/switch
Verify text "Guardado" or "Preferencias" or "Actualizado" is visible

title: Notification preferences persist after page reload
description: Verifies a saved notification toggle remains in the chosen state after reloading the Notifications page.

steps.description: Click on "Settings" / "Configuración" in the main navigation
Click the first visible notification preference toggle/switch

title: Profile validation: invalid email format shows error
description: Verifies the Profile form blocks saving when email format is invalid and shows a visible validation message.

steps.description: Click on "Settings" / "Configuración" in the main navigation
Verify text "correo" or "email" and "inválido" or "no válido" is visible

title: Profile validation: required fields show errors when cleared
description: Verifies required profile fields (if present) show validation errors when emptied and user tries to save.

steps.description: Click on "Settings" / "Configuración" in the main navigation

title: Switch between Profile and Notifications tabs without losing page context
description: Verifies a logged-in user can switch between settings tabs and the correct page content is shown each time.

steps.description: Click on "Settings" / "Configuración" in the main navigation

title: Cancel/Back behavior (if present) does not save changes implicitly
description: Verifies leaving the Profile page without saving does not show a save confirmation (and does not imply changes were saved).

steps.description: Click on "Settings" / "Configuración" in the main navigation
Fill "Nombre" / "Name" field with "QA Nombre No Guardado"
Verify text "Guardado" or "Cambios guardados" is not visible

title: Submit identity verification with official ID documents and see pending status
description: Verifies a logged-in user can submit identity verification and sees a pending/in-review status afterward.

steps.description: Click on the "Iniciar sesión" or "Login" button
Click on "Verification" / "Verificación" in the main navigation or user menu
Verify text "Verificación" or "Identity Verification" is visible

title: Verification page shows document upload inputs and submit control
description: Verifies the verification page UI contains document upload controls and a way to submit the request.

steps.description: Click on the "Iniciar sesión" or "Login" button
Click on "Verification" / "Verificación" in the main navigation or user menu
Verify element "Official ID" / "Documento de identidad" section is visible
Verify element "Submit" / "Enviar" / "Solicitar verificación" button is visible

title: Attempt to submit verification with required fields missing shows validation errors
description: Verifies the user cannot submit verification without providing required document inputs and sees validation feedback.

steps.description: Click on the "Iniciar sesión" or "Login" button
Click on "Verification" / "Verificación" in the main navigation or user menu

title: Access Admin Panel as authenticated user and see admin UI shell
description: Verifies an authenticated user can load the /admin page and see the admin panel UI elements.

title: Admin Panel page renders without obvious error state
description: Verifies the admin page loads without showing a generic error message or blank/empty screen indicators.

steps.description: Verify text "Something went wrong" is not visible

title: Admin Panel shows at least one actionable control (smoke)
description: Verifies the admin page includes at least one visible control suggesting admin functionality is present.

steps.description: Verify element "a button or link that looks like an admin action (for example, labeled 'Crear', 'Guardar', 'Actualizar', or 'Eliminar')" is visible

title: Admin Panel navigation persists (can reach Admin from main app shell)
description: Verifies the Admin page is reachable through the authenticated app navigation rather than direct URL entry after login.

steps.description: Verify element "primary navigation menu (sidebar or top nav)" is visible

title: Known limitation coverage: non-admin user can access /admin (risk acknowledgement)
description: Verifies the currently authenticated user can access /admin even if not an admin, reflecting the documented missing role checks (do not fail as a product bug here).

steps.description: Verify text "Acceso denegado" is not visible
